sources.title: VoxCPM 2 - VoxCPM 2.0 documentation
sources.snippet: VoxCPM 2 is the latest major release — a 2B parameter model trained on 2.36 million hours of multilingual data. It represents a significant leap in capacity, quality, and controllability over the 1.x series.

sources.title: GitHub - waydame/voxcpm: VoxCPM2: Tokenizer-Free TTS for Multilingual ...
sources.snippet: The model operates entirely in the latent space of AudioVAE V2, following a four-stage pipeline: LocEnc → TSLM → RALM → LocDiT, enabling rich expressiveness and 48kHz native audio output. For full architectural details, VoxCPM2-specific upgrades, and a model comparison table, see the Architecture Design.

sources.title: VoxCPM 2.0 documentation
sources.snippet: Current Technical Limitations: Although generally stable, the model may occasionally exhibit instability, especially with very long or expressive inputs. VoxCPM 2 introduces Voice Design and Style Control for more direct attribute control, though results may vary.

sources.title: VoxCPM2 | Tokenizer-Free Multilingual TTS for Voice Design and Cloning
sources.snippet: Open-source multilingual speech generation Tokenizer-free TTS built for voice design and faithful cloning. VoxCPM2 is a 2B-parameter speech model trained on 2M+ hours of multilingual audio. It synthesizes 30 languages and 9 Chinese dialects, creates new voices from natural-language prompts, and delivers controllable cloning with native 48kHz output.
